title: Register for the Nov 3 Ask A Biocurator Anything
content: Training News 2026 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Register for the Nov 3 Ask A Biocurator Anything 09/06 Register for the November 3 Open Discussion–Ask A Biocurator Anything ' class='img-responsive' style=''> Register for the November 3 Open Discussion–Ask A Biocurator Anything Bring any general questions about the deposition, validation, and biocuration process or about a specific entry to be curated by RCSB PDB (i.e., the depositor is located in the Americas) to this depositor-driven Office Hour. Materials will be not be presented. Breakout rooms will be used for private discussions as needed. Join Dr. Irina Persikova on: Tuesday November 3, 2026 1-2:00pm Eastern | 10:00am - 11am Pacific. Please register for this free event. An institutional email address for registration is preferred. You will receive confirmation and a Zoom link by email before the event.
